Compassionate Addiction Treatment

When we think about addiction, our thoughts will depend on our previous life experiences. Individuals who had childhood experiences with a loved one who struggled with an addiction will likely have a different perspective when compared to someone who has never had addiction touch their life or that of their loved ones.

As a progressive disease, addiction continues to worsen until a person stops using. While sobriety is a component of recovery, the other aspect of this is behavioral changes. If you continue engaging in addictive behaviors while remaining abstinent, are you truly in recovery? You may be sober, but you have yet to commit to changes that will enable you to live your best life.

Addiction Statistics in Santa Cruz

The Santa Cruz County Health Services Agency reported that approximately 22% of adults in our county needed help for a mental health or substance use concern. This rate was higher than the average for California state from 2012-2013.

Commonly abused drugs included in the same report for Santa Cruz County included marijuana, prescription drugs, cocaine, hallucinogens, inhalants, and heroin. This shows the importance of having access to appropriate and quality addiction and mental health treatment programs in the Santa Cruz area.

How to Find Detox Programs in Santa Cruz, CA

If you have been struggling with drugs and alcohol and have reached a place in your journey where you are ready to take a step toward a healthier lifestyle, there are multiple paths that you can take.

The first of which would be to speak with a healthcare or mental healthcare professional about your concerns and your goals. From here, you can talk about appropriate levels of care and specific treatment program referrals that may fit you well.

A second option would be to contact your insurance provider by calling the number on your ID card or by utilizing your online portal. Your insurance company can provide you with a list of in-network providers and help you understand what your financial responsibilities would be. However, they are not able to provide you with a level of care recommendation.

Another detail to consider is the area of Santa Cruz. We have beautiful views and communities that you would be able to enjoy while you utilize the different treatment options in our area.

If you live in the Santa Cruz area, choosing to attend local inpatient treatment programs can help you develop your support in your home community. This can include individuals you meet in treatment and those you meet in other activities, such as peer-led support groups.

Marina Harbor is a Detox Center Servicing Santa Cruz, CA

Addiction is a powerful mental health concern that can affect individuals of all backgrounds. Each individual will have their own unique experience, but some commonalities will be present. This can include changes to physical health, mental health, career status, finances, and relationships. A common experience that individuals experience while in active addiction is isolation. This often includes pulling away from family, friends, and other loved ones. Reaching out for help can feel more challenging if you feel as though your social support is limited.
